about: A-class files adopted with a known difference from the freeze commit (design doc 10, section 2.1). Each entry pins the file's git blob hash and says why; the guard lets exactly that content through, and any further edit is caught again.

core/checks/task_success.py.why: design 13 (video-native judgement): the frame-probe path, kept for old deliveries and injected tests, asks its probes in time order instead of shuffled; comments follow

dataset_level/caption.py.why: design 13 (video-native judgement): captions read the continuous videos (video captioner, media_protocol=video-caption/1 cache boundary); an 'unclear' caption counts as none

dataset_level/profile.py.why: design 13 (video-native judgement): comment: the grouping text is the video caption first, the annotation as fallback

dataset_level/reassign.py.why: design 13 (video-native judgement): grouping_text_and_source puts the video caption first and falls back to the annotation (was annotation first)

vlm_call_kinds.py.why: design 13 (video-native judgement): the call-kind notes describe the continuous-video requests
